run_evaluate_imnet: run the FixRes model evaluation script on ImageNet with a specified architecture and weights
run_multi_gpu_evaluation: run multi-GPU ImageNet evaluation using the run function with distributed training configuration
run_resnet50_evaluation: run ImageNet validation accuracy evaluation for a ResNet50 architecture model
run_pnasnet_evaluation: run ImageNet validation accuracy evaluation for a PNASNet architecture model
run_igam_resnext_evaluation: run ImageNet validation accuracy evaluation for an IGAM_Resnext101_32x48d architecture model
